description: When a role container initialises or updates the holon-coherence submodule inside a mounted worktree, its gitfile and core.worktree retain container-relative paths that break host-side git checkout during Stage 4 and Stage 5.
goal: Prevent role containers from leaving submodule gitfiles with unresolvable container paths in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/entrypoint/executor/repair.py (either stopping unnecessary submodule initialisation or rewriting host-valid relative gitdir paths via git submodule absorbgitdirs) and update Stage 5 in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/stages/calibrate.py so host-side stages detect any unresolvable submodule gitfile before checkout and repair it or fail clearly naming the offending file. Keep both modules strictly within their 350-line budgets and keep holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched. Add hermetic unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_executor_repair.py and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/stages/test_calibrate.py verifying that a worktree whose submodule gitfile points at a container path is repaired or rejected before Stage 5 checks out, and verify uv run pytest and uv run task lint pass. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Ensuring container git setup and pre-checkout checks keep submodule gitfiles host-valid prevents mid-checkout failures during calibration and review.
acceptance_criteria: Where a role container initialises or updates the holon-coherence submodule in the mounted worktree via entrypoint/executor/repair.py, either stop it (role containers do not need the submodule) or make it write host-valid, relative paths (`git submodule absorbgitdirs` / relative `gitdir:`).

Host-side pre-checkout checks in flow/stages/calibrate.py (and host stages) detect an unresolvable submodule gitfile before any checkout and repair it, or fail with a clear message naming the file, instead of failing mid-checkout.

Tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_executor_repair.py and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/stages/test_calibrate.py prove a worktree whose submodule gitfile points at a container path is repaired or rejected before Stage 5 checks out (keeping repair.py and calibrate.py within 350-line budgets and holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched); `uv run pytest -n auto --dist worksteal -m "not integration_test and not stress"`, `uv run task lint`, and `uv run task lint-docs` pass, and code is self-explaining (no docstrings; only '# why:' comments).
